title: Goliath Depot

sections.title: Goliath Depot
text: A door-slamming 2D arcade game taken straight from the early 80’s

sections.title: About Goliath Depot
text: Close all doors, kick the enemies and speedrun your way through 40 unique levels. Are you good enough to lift the curse of the Goliath Depot?

Goliath Depot is a door-slamming 2D arcade platformer in the style of the early 80’s. Close all doors, kick away the enemies and rack up your score in 4 worlds filled with single-screen levels inspired by tough-as-nail retro arcade platformers. Are you good enough to lift the curse of the Goliath Depot?
«Built around a concept introduced in Hotel Mario, a much-maligned CD-i title.»
«If you’ve enjoyed the recent string of retro arcade throwbacks that have been brought to the Switch.»
